title: Error 21608 still blocks unverified recipients after you upgrade the Twilio account
symptoms: 21608 Upgrade and create an approved primary compliance profile to reach unverified numbers
Messages reach your own phone but no one else's
cause: Trial accounts can only message verified numbers, and an upgraded account keeps that limit until its primary compliance profile is approved.
fix: On trial, verify each recipient. On a paid account, submit the primary compliance profile in Trust Hub and wait for approval; verified caller IDs are only a testing stopgap.
affected: Twilio trial accounts and upgraded accounts without an approved primary compliance profile, documented October 2026
